body: Second global-rule lead returned SHIPPED. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/.windful-ocean/pull/300, branch docs/pointer-carries-three-fields cut from origin/main at 5dc18444, commit 94f336e5, one file, five lines added and nine removed.U+000AU+000AThe pointer section at .claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md:88-97 claimed four fields; it now states three. Four `focus` occurrences across lines 90, 91, 93 and 97 carried three distinct false claims: a fourth field holding declared criteria, a required-on-type-but-optional-on-read contract with a missing value read back as an empty list, and update_thread writing it. All four sat inside one section and a case-insensitive sweep of the rest of the file found nothing else.U+000AU+000AOne clause was kept deliberately, saying a stored focus key is dropped on read. The lead's reason: this is current behaviour rather than migration trivia, since readPointer projects exactly three keys out of whatever it parses and test/unit/pointer.test.ts:164 pins that, and any machine that resumed a thread before PR 191 still has the key sitting in active-thread.json on disk, where a reader finding an unmentioned key cannot otherwise tell stale from damaged.U+000AU+000ASuite state confirmed rather than assumed: 953 tests, 949 pass, 4 fail, exit 1, all four in scripts/repo/tests/skill-router-lint.test.mjs at lines 77, 177, 183 and 191, no fifth failure introduced. The lead marked as unverified that it did not run the suite on main for a side-by-side, so "the same four" rests on name matching against the set I handed it rather than on its own measured baseline.U+000AU+000ATwo observations it declined to act on. The .windful-ocean local main ref points at ecf08cc7 while origin/main is at 5dc18444, a divergence predating this session; the branch was cut from origin/main so the PR is unaffected. And the one-sided-drift claim was independently confirmed: logbook's own copy at docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:89 already says three fields with zero focus mentions.U+000AU+000AHuman's .windful-ocean checkout has now moved twice this session and sits on docs/pointer-carries-three-fields. It started the session on chore/relax-pr-gates, whose PR 298 is already merged. The sibling branch docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived is unchanged at 9f154ab3.U+000AU+000AAll four dispatched units are complete. Every criterion this session touched remains OPEN, because each is true only on an unmerged branch and merge is human-gated.
